content: Take your next dose at the regular scheduled time. Storage Instructions: Store this medication at room temperature. It may also be stored in the refrigerator to improve its taste. However, do not freeze this product. Disposal Instructions: Do not flush medications down the toilet or pour them into a drain unless specifically instructed to do so. Properly discard this product when it is expired or no longer needed. Missed Dose Instructions: If you are taking this medication on a regular schedule and miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember. If it is close to the time of your next scheduled dose, skip the missed dose and resume your regular dosing schedule. Do not double the dose to catch up. Important Information About This Product: This information is a summary and does not contain all possible details about this product. It does not guarantee that the product is safe, effective, or appropriate for your specific situation. This information is not intended to replace individualized medical advice. Always consult your healthcare professional for complete information about this product and your specific health needs. Lifestyle Recommendations: Incorporating lifestyle changes such as participating in stress reduction programs, quitting smoking, limiting alcohol consumption, and making dietary adjustments (e.g., avoiding caffeine, fatty foods, and certain spices) may enhance the effectiveness of this medication.
